items.title: 7.5 Computing's Impact on Individuals and Society (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of computing's impact (PDF 186).

blocks.text: Computing systems ne hamare rehne, kaam karne aur aapas mein baat cheet (communicate) karne ka tareeqa bilkul badal (revolutionize) diya hai aur society (muashre) mein bari tabdeeliyan layi hain. Internet, smartphones aur artificial intelligence (AI, yaani machine ki sochne jaisi salahiyat) jaisi technologies ke aam istemal ke positive (achhe) aur negative (bure) dono asar hue hain.

blocks.prompt: Computing ka ek positive (achha) aur ek negative (bura) asar bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Positive: maloomat aur taleem tak aasan access (pohanch) (jaise Coursera, edX). Negative: ghalat maloomat aur fake news ka tezi se phailna (jaise COVID-19 ke dauran).

items: Internet, smartphones aur AI ne zindagi, kaam aur baat cheet badal di; asar positive bhi, negative bhi.
